Medical Officer '''Grenvil Taadus''' was part of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] forces stationed on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Bakura/Legends|Bakura]]. During the [[Battle of Bakura]], Taadus attempted to save the life of [[Dev Sibwarra]] but ultimately failed. After the surrender of Imperial forces to [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance]] and [[Bakuran]] forces, Taadus defected to the Alliance. He was transferred to the [[Hospital ship/Legends|medical frigate]] [[Mercy (hospital ship)|''Mercy'']].
